description: This source file implements the AuthService class, which provides authentication functionalities such as user registration and login within a .NET project. It manages user credentials, generates JWT tokens, and interacts with user repository interfaces.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides authentication services including user registration and login, JWT token generation, and interaction with user repository.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Handles user registration by checking for existing users, hashing password, creating a new user record, and generating a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: LoginAsync
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying credentials and generating a JWT token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: GenerateJwtToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT access token for an authenticated user with configurable issuer, audience, and expiration settings.
